items.title: Akamai Technologies (AKAM) Wraps Up $1.1 Billion Notes Deal For Cloud Buildout
items.summary: Akamai Technologies (NasdaqGS:AKAM) completed a US$1.1b convertible senior notes offering to support its Cloud Infrastructure Services business. The new notes are intended to refinance upcoming debt maturities and fund capital expenditures tied to cloud and AI infrastructure projects. Akamai entered note hedge and warrant transactions alongside the offering that are designed to address potential dilution for existing shareholders.
